business.description: Lorenzini Apparels Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing, designing and marketing of readymade garments offering diverse range of formal, semi-formal and casual wear for men and women. The company serves customers through retail and e-commerce channels and also outsources garment manufacturing on job work basis to third party contractors.

outlook.statement: As India continues its dynamic journey forward, Lorenzini Apparels Limited is committed to playing a key role in the country's transformative growth by fulfilling diverse needs of its consumers. Our comprehensive portfolio of businesses is strategically positioned to meet the aspirations of Indian consumers as rising per capita income fuels their discretionary spending in fashion & lifestyle.

We will continue to focus on innovation, sustainability, and customer-centricity, ensuring that your Company remains a trusted partner for our valued customers and a beacon of excellence in the textile industry.

India's apparel industry is set for steady growth driven by favorable demographics, rising incomes, urbanization, and evolving fashion preferences. Digital adoption and demand for branded, personalized clothing are transforming consumer behavior, especially in Tier II-IV cities. Despite short-term macroeconomic pressures like inflation and shifting spending patterns, long-term prospects remain strong.
The management is optimistic about the future and expects the business to perform well in the forthcoming year.
